page.overview:
Who is Will?

Will is the first of the Elite Four in Johto. He is a -type trainer.

Will is a mysterious man, who has Lilac hair, at times, covering his domino mask, and wears a suit, posed with a lot of energy.

Will wears a maroon suit, with a dark vest, and a red tie. His eyes are concealed.

Will's appearance remains the same as it is in Gold and Silver.
